name: okjlpt
description: Practise JLPT (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test) questions from past tests, N1 to N5, with explanations in English or Chinese.

interface.longDescription:
Practise for the Japanese-Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) right in the chat. Ask for a question at any level from N1 to N5 in vocabulary, grammar or reading, and OK JLPT shows it as a card with four options. Tap an answer to see whether it is right and why, with an explanation in English, Simplified Chinese or Traditional Chinese. Tap Next question to keep going. You can also ask when the next test is, how long each section takes and what the pass marks are.

The questions come from the free past tests on okjlpt.com. Listening questions and questions with pictures are not shown in the chat; to take a whole test with listening and an estimated score, open it on okjlpt.com. No account is needed.

OK JLPT is an independent study tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Japan Foundation or Japan Educational Exchanges and Services, which run the JLPT. Scores and answers on OK JLPT are for practice only.
capabilities: JLPT test dates and pass marks
defaultPrompt: Give me a JLPT N3 grammar question.
When is the next JLPT and what is the N2 pass mark?

positive.description: Ask for a question at one level and section; answer it on the card.
positive.prompt: Give me a JLPT N3 grammar question.
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows one N3 grammar question with four options and the test it comes from. Tapping an option marks the right answer in green (and a wrong pick in red) and shows the explanation, with Next question and a link to the whole test on okjlpt.com.

positive.description: A Chinese-speaking learner asks for a reading question; the explanation follows their language.
positive.prompt: 我要考 N2，出一道阅读题
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows an N2 reading passage in a scrollable box, the question and four options. After tapping an option, the verdict and explanation are in Simplified Chinese and the link opens the Simplified Chinese page of that test.

positive.description: The learner answers in the chat instead of tapping the card.
positive.prompt: Give me an N5 vocabulary question. My answer is 2.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows an N5 vocabulary question, then checks option 2 with check_jlpt_answer and says whether it is right, which option is correct and why, without guessing the answer itself.

positive.description: Keep practising: the next question is new.
positive.prompt: Give me a JLPT N4 vocabulary question, then another one I haven't seen.
positive.expected_behavior: Two different N4 vocabulary questions are shown; the second call passes the first question's id in exclude, so the same question does not repeat. Tapping Next question on the card does the same.

positive.prompt: When is the next JLPT and what is the N2 pass mark?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the next test date and the N2 pass mark (90 out of 180, with the minimum for each section) from the facts returned, and links to the test dates page on okjlpt.com.

negative.description: General translation is not a JLPT practice request; OK JLPT should not be used.
negative.prompt: Translate this into English: 明日は雨が降るそうです。

negative.description: Writing help is outside the app; no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Help me write a self-introduction in Japanese for a job interview.

negative.description: Asking for the answers to an upcoming real test; the app has no such content and must not invent it.
negative.prompt: Show me the answers to the December 2026 JLPT N2.

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and takes no payments in ChatGPT. It links to okjlpt.com only to take a whole practice test.

publication.release_notes: First release: JLPT N1–N5 practice questions (vocabulary, grammar, reading) as a card with answer checking and explanations in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, plus JLPT test dates and pass marks.

zh-CN.subtitle: 在聊天里练 JLPT 历年试题
zh-CN.description:
直接在聊天里准备日本语能力测试（JLPT）。说出等级（N1–N5）和题型（文字词汇、语法、阅读），OK JLPT 就会出一道题，以四个选项的卡片显示。点选项马上知道对错和原因，解析有简体中文、繁体中文和英文。点「下一题」接着练。也可以问考试日期、各科时间和合格线。

题目来自 okjlpt.com 的免费试题。听力题和带图片的题不在聊天里出；想做整套（含听力、估分），请到 okjlpt.com。不需要账号。

OK JLPT 是独立的学习工具，与举办 JLPT 的日本国际交流基金会、日本国际教育支援协会没有关联。

zh-TW.subtitle: 在對話裡練習日檢試題
zh-TW.description:
直接在對話裡準備日本語能力試驗（JLPT）。說出級數（N1–N5）和題型（文字語彙、文法、讀解），OK JLPT 就會出一題，以四個選項的卡片顯示。點選項馬上知道對錯和原因，解析有繁體中文、簡體中文和英文。點「下一題」繼續練習。也可以問考試日期、各科時間和及格分數。

題目來自 okjlpt.com 的免費試題。聽解題和有圖片的題不在對話裡出；想做整回（含聽解、估分），請到 okjlpt.com。不需要帳號。

OK JLPT 是獨立的學習工具，與舉辦 JLPT 的日本國際交流基金會、日本國際教育支援協會沒有關聯。

ja-JP.subtitle: JLPTの問題をチャットで練習
ja-JP.description:
日本語能力試験（JLPT）の対策をチャットの中で。レベル（N1〜N5）と分野（文字・語彙、文法、読解）を伝えると、OK JLPT が4択の問題をカードで表示します。選択肢をタップすると正解かどうかと解説が表示されます（解説は英語・中国語）。「次の問題」で続けて練習できます。試験日や各科目の時間、合格点も質問できます。

問題は okjlpt.com の無料の試験問題から出題します。聴解や図のある問題はチャットでは出題しません。聴解を含む全問の演習と得点の目安は okjlpt.com で。アカウントは不要です。

OK JLPT は独立した学習ツールで、JLPT を実施する国際交流基金および日本国際教育支援協会とは関係ありません。
